name: live-avatar-3d-video
description: Comprehensive skill for building, rigging, animating, and rendering interactive 3D live avatars, real-time audio-reactive viseme lip-sync, dynamic procedural gestures, and code-driven video creation using Three.js, MMD/VRM, Web Audio FFT, Remotion, and Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash.

name: awesome-n8n-templates
description: Production-ready n8n workflow blueprints, AI agents, RAG pipelines, CRM integrations, and webhook automations based on enescingoz/awesome-n8n-templates. Use when architecting backend automations, integrating external services (Gmail, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Notion), designing AI agent loops, or building headless microservice pipelines.

name: ecc
description: Agent harness performance optimization system and agentic engineering toolkit based on Everything Claude Code (ECC). Provides specialized subagent personas, reflexive memory loops, continuous learning hooks, and AgentShield security scanning. Use whenever orchestrating multi-agent tasks, optimizing agent performance, conducting security audits, or managing long-running coding workflows.

name: graphify
description: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.

name: hallmark
description: Design skill for websites and new pages that look designed, not generated. Use when the user asks to build or design something new, or names Hallmark. Never use it on an existing design unless the user names Hallmark, as in `/hallmark redesign <path>`.

name: live-avatar-3d-video
description: Comprehensive skill for building, rigging, animating, and rendering interactive 3D live avatars, real-time audio-reactive viseme lip-sync, dynamic procedural gestures, and code-driven video creation using Three.js, MMD/VRM, Web Audio FFT, Remotion, and Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash.

name: motion
description: Production-ready web animation, gesture, physics springs, and layout transition skill based on Motion (motiondivision/motion, formerly Framer Motion). Covers motion/react, vanilla motion, Vue 3, scroll-driven timelines, layoutId morphing, and zero-hallucination agent animation guidelines. Use whenever building interactive UIs, animations, page transitions, or micro-interactions.

name: rea-analysis-optimization
description: Optimize REA providers and shared analysis workflows for agent context, latency, CPU, and memory while preserving correctness and Evidence. Use for analysis bottlenecks and cache or query design; CI/test-suite optimization belongs to rea-ci-tests-audit.

name: rea-changelog-update
description: Prepare or rewrite REA release changelogs and GitHub release notes from pinned Git history, with verified contributor thanks and Release Please synchronization.

name: rea-ci-tests-audit
description: Audit REA CI and test suites for correctness, fixture drift, false passes, and measured performance; use for suite or workflow investigations and efficiency changes, rather than ordinary feature testing or a single test failure.

name: rea-tool-design
description: Design or change REA investigation tools, CLI/MCP contracts, provider capabilities, and Evidence semantics.

name: reverse-engineer-anything
description: Reverse engineer native, managed, Electron/JavaScript, packaged, firmware, and browser targets with REA. Use shipped-artifact or requested runtime evidence to explain features, compare versions, decompile code, or guide a reconstruction. Skip REA for ordinary source-repository architecture analysis.

name: superpowers
description: Disciplined software engineering methodology and tool integration for agents based on Jesse Vincent's Superpowers framework with native Google Antigravity mappings. Enforces strict Test-Driven Development (TDD), interactive user specification before coding, rigorous architectural planning, and clean subagent task delegation. Use when designing, building, or refactoring critical features.

name: voicestudio
description: Generate local speech with saved or designed voices, transcribe audio, and automate dubbing or narration workflows through VoiceStudio's REST API or MCP server. Use when the user wants to work with VoiceStudio audio or connect it to an agent or automation.
